text:
sarah_m: Quick sprint-check for postmortem follow-ups. Focus: headroom knob, quota throttles, scheduler fairness, sims, and canary gating. Short owners + ETAs please.

mike_g: I'll run sim matrix (baseline / conservative / pre-warm). 48h replay with cold-KV windows. Will post p50/p95/p99 + cost delta. ETA Wed EOD.

leo_ops: I'll prototype reserved_pool_percent infra flag + kube-scheduler config for prefer-preempting batch best-effort. PR for infra + scheduler by next Tue.

anya: I'll update postmortem doc with recurring-pattern table and add an emergency runbook (commands and escalation). Draft PR by Monday.

olivia_pm: Monitoring gating: need alloc_mismatch_ratio metric + pre-alert when predicted vs actual deviates >15% for 2m. I'll own alert defs. Block rollout until present. ETA: before canary.

sam_s: I'll own the canary plan and rollback scripts. Proposed canary: 3% traffic, 4h window, auto-rollback on p99 regress >25% or alloc alerts. Need sims + alerts + runbook to be ready.

jordan_r: Product short-term mitigation: per-tenant soft burst buckets (token-bucket) to throttle noisy tenants. I'll draft policy + email snippet. ETA Tue.

mike_g: Simulator commands I'm using (shareable):
```
# baseline replay
./simulator replay --trace traces/july-2056-spike.json --rate-mult 8 --cold-kv --out results/baseline.json
\n# pre-warm enabled
./simulator replay --trace traces/july-2056-spike.json --rate-mult 8 --cold-kv --prewarm 8 --prewarm-ttl 10m --out results/prewarm.json
```

mike_g: I'll include numbers for scale events, average startup time, and cost delta for each config.

leo_ops: For scheduler diff: add priorityClass "inference-critical" and a scheduler policy to prefer evicting pods with label "queue=batch,best_effort=true". Will include manifest in PR.

anya: Runbook snippet I'll add:
1) enable reserved pool: `infractl headroom set --percent 10`
2) enable soft throttle (tenant): `quotactl throttle --tenant $ID --rate 50%`
3) notify #incidents + page on alloc_mismatch alert

infra-bot: Reminder: planned node-image rollout Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Avoid canary overlap.

olivia_pm: Also request a lead indicator: "scale_loop_retries_per_min" with anomaly alert. Helps detect autoscaler oscillation early.

sam_s: Canary gating checklist (must pass): 1) sims show p99 improvement or acceptable tradeoff, 2) alerts in place, 3) runbook + rollback tested, 4) customer messaging drafted.

jordan_r: I'll coordinate messaging with @anya. Draft will include why throttles exist and expected timeline + opt-out instructions for enterprise customers.

sarah_m: Owner recap for the ticket: mike_g -> sims & numbers (Wed EOD), leo_ops -> scheduler + reserved_pool PR (Tue), anya -> postmortem + runbook (Mon), olivia_pm -> alerts & lead metrics (pre-canary), sam_s -> canary + rollback (post-sims), jordan_r -> product throttling policy + messaging (Tue).

sarah_m: We'll reconvene Fri 09:30 to review sims and decide canary window. If anything slips, call it out in this thread. Thanks. :thumbsup:
